_note: Five keyframes at 6s anchors (t=3,9,15,21,27) locking in composition before any video or final render. User reviews each keyframe; on approval each becomes either (A) the static plate for its 6s block or (B/C) the seed image for a Grok img2vid call.

episode.basis: All 5 keyframes become seed images for Grok img2vid 6s clips

baseImage._note: Run PIL inpaint on the chalkboard text zone (approx x=80..840, y=260..420 in 1248×832 source) to get a clean empty-chalkboard plate. Upscale to 1920×1080 while preserving the right-side character crop.

framingRule._note: Character occupies right 22%. Left 78% must stay empty chalkboard texture for post typography.

styleLock.renderStyle: 2D anime illustration, flat shading, crisp line-art, matching docs/example/Daehan_2D.jpg
styleLock.avoid: 3D render, photorealistic, volumetric lighting, depth blur, realistic skin texture

characterLock.hat: black gat with gold ornamental band and red tassels
characterLock.outfit: plain black durumagi hanbok with white inner collar, black gloves on both hands
characterLock.props: small tied paper scroll held near left hip (matches Daehan_2D baseline; do not enlarge, do not move to board area)

keyframes.pose: front-facing, warm gentle smile, mouth closed or nearly closed, right hand resting at side, left hand holding scroll at hip

keyframes.purpose: introducing today's sentence, already into follow-me block
keyframes.pose: front-facing, slight right-tilt of head, mouth open mid-syllable, right hand raised chest-height with open palm toward the board (but arm stays within right 22%)
keyframes.chalkboard: completely empty (sentence typography is added in post, not drawn here)

keyframes.purpose: follow-me listening beat, inviting learner to repeat
keyframes.pose: front-facing, head slightly tilted, right hand cupped near right ear, closed gentle smile
front-facing, right arm extended slightly leftward at shoulder height with index finger pointing — only the gloved hand may cross into left chalkboard zone, body stays in right 22%
front-facing, right hand raised near shoulder with open palm in a small wave, bright smile, mouth slightly open as if saying '안녕'

reviewChecklist: Character occupies right ~22% of frame in every KF
Left ~78% of chalkboard is completely empty (no text, no chalk marks, no scroll overlap)
Same silver hair, violet eyes, black gat, durumagi across all 5 KFs
Scroll prop small and at hip, not enlarged into board
Pose changes per KF readable at a glance (opening calm → speaking → listening → pointing → waving)
